name: Enrich Layer
desc: Professional network data enrichment API — company profiles, person data, work emails, and more.

actions.name: get_company_profile
actions.description: Get structured data of a Company Profile from a professional network URL (1 credit)

actions.name: get_person_profile
actions.description: Get structured data of a Person Profile from a professional network URL (1 credit)

actions.name: get_school_profile
actions.description: Get structured data of a School Profile from a professional network URL (1 credit)

actions.name: get_company_lookup
actions.description: Resolve a Company Profile from company name, domain, or location (2 credits)

actions.name: get_company_id_lookup
actions.displayName: Look Up Company by Numeric ID
actions.description: Resolve the vanity ID of a company from its numeric ID (0 credits)

actions.name: get_person_lookup
actions.description: Look up a person by name and company information (2 credits)

actions.name: get_role_lookup
actions.description: Find the person who most closely matches a specified role at a company (3 credits)

actions.name: get_employee_listing
actions.description: Get a list of employees of a company (3 credits per employee returned)

actions.name: get_employee_count
actions.description: Get the total number of employees of a company (1 credit)

actions.name: get_employee_search
actions.description: Search employees of a company by job title using boolean or regex keywords (10 credits base + 3 per match)

actions.name: get_student_listing
actions.description: Get a list of students at a school (3 credits per student returned)

actions.name: get_work_email_lookup
actions.description: Get the work email address for a professional network profile. 95%+ deliverability guarantee (3 credits)

actions.name: get_reverse_email_lookup
actions.description: Find social media profiles from an email address. Works with both personal and work emails (3 credits)

actions.name: get_reverse_phone_lookup
actions.description: Find social media profiles from a phone number (3 credits)

actions.name: get_personal_contact
actions.description: Find personal phone numbers from a social media profile (1 credit per number returned)

actions.name: get_personal_email
actions.description: Find personal email addresses from a social media profile (1 credit per email returned)

actions.name: get_disposable_email_check
actions.description: Check if an email address belongs to a disposable email service (0 credits)

actions.name: get_company_picture
actions.description: Get the profile picture URL of a company from cached profiles (0 credits)

actions.name: get_person_picture
actions.description: Get the profile picture URL of a person from cached profiles (0 credits)

actions.name: get_job_profile
actions.description: Get structured data of a job posting (2 credits)

actions.name: get_job_search
actions.description: List jobs posted by a company with optional filters (2 credits)

actions.name: get_job_count
actions.description: Count the number of jobs posted by a company (2 credits)

actions.name: get_company_search
actions.description: Search for companies matching a set of criteria across an exhaustive dataset (3 credits per company URL returned)

actions.name: get_person_search
actions.description: Search for people matching a set of criteria across an exhaustive dataset (3 credits per profile URL returned)

actions.name: get_credit_balance
actions.description: View your Enrich Layer API credit balance (0 credits)

actions.name: custom_api_call
actions.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
